Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- check on whether the unit has been QC'ed for labeling
 -- has been removed as a component conversion can take
 -- place at any point of time
 --
 begin
 select bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time,
 temp_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if (temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null) and
 temp_contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: OLD_PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code to be converted or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number := 0;
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 -- Split components cannot be converted
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :old_product_code;
 if temp_count > 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0157');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code,
 null, 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 -- A component already pooled or relabeled cannot
 -- be converted simply because it does not exist
 -- anymore
 select distinct a.product_code, product_desc, product_type,
 bag_id, nvl(pheresis_flag,'N')
 into :old_product_code, :s_old_desc, :old_product_type,
 :GLOBAL.old_bag_id, :pheresis_unit 
 from components a, valid_products b
 where a.unit_id = :unit_id and
 a.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 a.product_code = :old_product_code and
 a.component_status = 'L' and
 a.reject_reason_code is null and
 a.product_code = b.product_code and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select nvl(sum(nvl(number_of_bags,0) - nvl(bags_used,0)),0)
 into temp_count
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :old_product_code;
 if temp_count <= 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0011');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif temp_count is null 
 then
 show_error('0076');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0076');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_set_id number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_valid_set VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_valid_prod VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

 cursor c1 is
 select set_id from product_matrix
 where product_type = :new_product_type
 and bag_code <= :GLOBAL.bag_code;
 cursor c2 is
 select distinct product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 product_code != :old_product_code and
 relabel_product_code is null;
 -- pooled components are inclusive
 -- relabeled components are not considered
 -- in the search for an optimal
 -- combination
begin
 
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 -- message('Bag Code: '||:GLOBAL.bag_code);
 begin
 select product_code, product_desc, product_type
 into :new_product_code, :s_new_desc, :new_product_type
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :new_product_code
 and product_type != 'CRYO'
 and nvl(pheresis_flag,'N') = :pheresis_unit
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_product_conv
 where target_product_code = :new_product_code and
 source_product_code = :old_product_code and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0149');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :new_product_code;
 -- relabeled and pooled components are
 -- considered as components made from the unit
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0159');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 IF :old_product_type != :new_product_type THEN
 begin
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 for temp_set in c1
 loop
 -- message('Entered loop');
 -- message('Set #: '||to_char(temp_set.set_id));
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 temp_valid_prod := 'Y';
 for temp_prod in c2 loop
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from product_matrix
 where set_id=temp_set.set_id
 and product_type = (SELECT product_type 
 FROM valid_products 
 WHERE product_code = temp_prod.product_code
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_valid_prod := 'N';
 exit;
 when OTHERS
 then
 -- message('Too many rows');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_prod = 'Y'
 then
 -- message('Valid Set: '||to_char(temp_set.set_id));
 temp_valid_set := 'Y';
 exit;
 else
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 end if;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_set != 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0137');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
end;
